caption: The drawing features a single clear glass decanter with an ornate stopper set against a plain, light beige background. The decanter is vertically oriented and centrally positioned. The glass stopper at the top is spherical and decorated with a spiral-cut pattern. The neck of the decanter is slender, leading to a broader midsection with intricate, raised designs that resemble leaf or oval motifs, and the base is rounded with a series of small, circular protrusions near the bottom. The overall depiction is detailed with a focus on transparency, shading, and highlights to illustrate the reflective and refractive properties of the glass, and the colors are predominantly shades of gray and muted brown with subtle hints of blue to convey the appearance of clear glass. The background is blank and unadorned, emphasizing the detailed depiction of the decanter.
title: Decanter
